```{=html}
<div class="project-filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter projects by area">
  <button type="button" class="filter-btn" data-cat="">All</button>
  <button type="button" class="filter-btn" data-cat="Water Quality">Water Quality</button>
  <button type="button" class="filter-btn" data-cat="Dashboards">Dashboards</button>
  <button type="button" class="filter-btn" data-cat="Machine Learning">Machine Learning</button>
</div>

<style>
  /* Area buttons replace Quarto's full category sidebar on this page */
  .quarto-listing-category-title,
  .quarto-listing-category,
  #quarto-margin-sidebar {
    display: none;
  }

  /* Reclaim the width Quarto reserves for that sidebar */
  main.content.column-page-left {
    grid-column: page-start / page-end;
  }
</style>

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".filter-btn");
    const setActive = (cat) => {
      buttons.forEach((b) => {
        const on = b.dataset.cat === cat;
        b.classList.toggle("active", on);
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on);
      });
    };

    // Keep button state in sync when a tag on a card is clicked
    const quartoFilter = window.quartoListingCategory;
    window.quartoListingCategory = (encoded) => {
      quartoFilter(encoded);
      setActive(decodeURIComponent(atob(encoded)));
    };

    buttons.forEach((b) => {
      b.addEventListener("click", () => {
        window.quartoListingCategory(btoa(encodeURIComponent(b.dataset.cat)));
      });
    });

    const match = window.location.hash.match(/category=([^&]*)/);
    setActive(match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : "");
  });
</script>
```
